proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: I used the room calculator on their site and it said about two gallons for our bedroom. The quote said two gallons of eggshell, one of semi-gloss for the trim, and the price landed inside the range the site showed. No surprises at all.
reviews.name: Megan T.

reviews.text: We did the whole downstairs of our Apex house over four days. Each morning Priya texted which rooms were off limits that day, so the kids always had somewhere to be.
reviews.name: Rashid A.

reviews.text: They painted three big samples on our living room wall and told us to look at them at night. The gray we loved in the store turned purple after dark. Glad we checked first.
reviews.name: Courtney L.

reviews.text: Cabinets were sprayed in their shop and the boxes were done in place with the kitchen sealed off in plastic. It took a week and the doors close as quietly as before.
reviews.name: Brian K.

reviews.text: They waited three dry days after washing the deck before staining it, even though I asked them to hurry. Two years on, the stain is still even and water still beads on the boards.
reviews.name: Tasha W.

reviews.text: Listing photos were on a Friday and we called on the Monday. They repainted the kitchen, hall and two bedrooms in neutral white by Thursday and cleaned up after themselves.
reviews.name: Gary P.

reviews.text: Corner cracks and about forty nail pops in a ten-year-old house. Every one was patched and you cannot find them now, even with the light hitting the wall sideways.
reviews.name: Nicole D.

proof.guarantee: If our paint peels or our cut lines are off within a year, we come back and touch it up.
